def all_even(xs: list[int]) -> list[int] fail Bad:
    """Check every element in parallel. On failure, return the failure of the lowest-index bad element, whichever thread finishes first."""
    post out.len() == xs.len()
    ex all_even([2, 4]) == [2, 4]
    ex all_even([]) == []

    for i in range(xs.len()):
        v = rs[i]
        if v % 2 == 1:
            fail Bad(n=xs[i])
        res.append(v)
    return res
